extraction.notes: Whole document read. Horizontal passages addressed to all partners were checked; one passage naming cyber-resilience is extracted with theme_doubtful. Not extracted: 'Green Agenda and sustainable connectivity' (no digital content stated), and passages on other countries (for example online harassment in Montenegro).
